title: File format or table format?

rows.label: Describes
values: How one file stores its rows and columns
Which files make up a table, and its history

rows.label: Transactions
values: None; a file is written once

rows.label: Schema changes
values: Each file carries its own schema
Tracked centrally; columns change without rewrites

rows.label: Time travel
values: Yes, until old snapshots are expired

tip: They stack rather than compete. A table format is metadata that points at files in a file format, almost always Parquet, so you choose one of each.
